## Hi there!
I am a research fellow specializing in clinical epidemiology. My work integrates epidemiological and statistical methods into clinical research to improve prevention of chronic conditions and patient outcomes.

### Education
**Master of Public Health (MPH)** | Iran University of Medical Sciences | 2023 <br>
**Doctor of Medicine (MD)** | Tehran University of Medical Sciences | 2020 

### Current Position
**Research Fellow in Health Epidemiology** | University of Leeds, UK
